(ns ucs-plus
  (:require

```
:::



## UCS With Costs
To demonstrate how **UCS** differs from **BFS** when costs are considered, we'll create a version with custom costs.


::: {.sourceClojure}
```clojure
(def dag-data-with-costs
  (dag/build-dag-data
   dag-structure
   node-levels
   {:root-node "Operating-System"
    :node-costs {"Email" 5  ; Make Email path more expensive
                 "Browser" 2
                 "Social-Media" 3
                 "File" 2
                 "Docs" 1  ; Make Docs path cheaper
                 "Games" 4
                 "Word" 3
                 "Excel" 4
                 "PowerPoint" 5
                 "Excel-Child1" 1}}))
```
:::



### Cost-Aware Path Comparison


::: {.sourceClojure}
```clojure
(bfs dag-data "Excel-Child1")

{"nodes":[{"id":"Operating-System","name":"Operating-System","level":0,"cost":1,"parent":null,"x":0,"y":0,"highlighted":"Operating-System"},{"id":"Browser","name":"Browser","level":1,"cost":2,"parent":"Operating-System","x":-200,"y":150,"highlighted":"Browser"},{"id":"Email","name":"Email","level":1,"cost":5,"parent":"Operating-System","x":0,"y":150,"highlighted":null},{"id":"Social-Media","name":"Social-Media","level":1,"cost":3,"parent":"Operating-System","x":200,"y":150,"highlighted":null},{"id":"Docs","name":"Docs","level":2,"cost":1,"parent":"Browser","x":-320,"y":300,"highlighted":"Docs"},{"id":"Maps","name":"Maps","level":2,"cost":1,"parent":"Browser","x":-240,"y":300,"highlighted":null},{"id":"Search","name":"Search","level":2,"cost":1,"parent":"Browser","x":-160,"y":300,"highlighted":null},{"id":"Chat","name":"Chat","level":2,"cost":1,"parent":"Email","x":-80,"y":300,"highlighted":null},{"id":"Cloud","name":"Cloud","level":2,"cost":1,"parent":"Email","x":0,"y":300,"highlighted":null},{"id":"File","name":"File","level":2,"cost":2,"parent":"Email","x":80,"y":300,"highlighted":null},{"id":"Games","name":"Games","level":2,"cost":4,"parent":"Social-Media","x":160,"y":300,"highlighted":null},{"id":"Photos","name":"Photos","level":2,"cost":1,"parent":"Social-Media","x":240,"y":300,"highlighted":null},{"id":"Videos","name":"Videos","level":2,"cost":1,"parent":"Social-Media","x":320,"y":300,"highlighted":null},{"id":"PowerPoint","name":"PowerPoint","level":3,"cost":5,"parent":"File","x":-200,"y":450,"highlighted":null},{"id":"Excel","name":"Excel","level":3,"cost":4,"parent":"Email","x":0,"y":450,"highlighted":null},{"id":"Word","name":"Word","level":3,"cost":3,"parent":"File","x":200,"y":450,"highlighted":"Word"},{"id":"PowerPoint-Child1","name":"PowerPoint-Child1","level":4,"cost":1,"parent":"PowerPoint","x":-320,"y":600,"highlighted":null},{"id":"PowerPoint-Child2","name":"PowerPoint-Child2","level":4,"cost":1,"parent":"PowerPoint","x":-240,"y":600,"highlighted":null},{"id":"PowerPoint-Child3","name":"PowerPoint-Child3","level":4,"cost":1,"parent":"PowerPoint","x":-160,"y":600,"highlighted":null},{"id":"Excel-Child1","name":"Excel-Child1","level":4,"cost":1,"parent":"Excel","x":-80,"y":600,"highlighted":"Excel-Child1"},{"id":"Excel-Child2","name":"Excel-Child2","level":4,"cost":1,"parent":"Excel","x":0,"y":600,"highlighted":null},{"id":"Excel-Child3","name":"Excel-Child3","level":4,"cost":1,"parent":"Excel","x":80,"y":600,"highlighted":null},{"id":"Word-Child1","name":"Word-Child1","level":4,"cost":1,"parent":"Word","x":160,"y":600,"highlighted":null},{"id":"Word-Child2","name":"Word-Child2","level":4,"cost":1,"parent":"Word","x":240,"y":600,"highlighted":null},{"id":"Word-Child3","name":"Word-Child3","level":4,"cost":1,"parent":"Word","x":320,"y":600,"highlighted":null}],"links":[{"source":"Email","target":"Chat","cost":1,"highlighted":null},{"source":"Email","target":"Cloud","cost":1,"highlighted":null},{"source":"Email","target":"Excel","cost":4,"highlighted":null},{"source":"Email","target":"File","cost":2,"highlighted":null},{"source":"File","target":"Excel","cost":4,"highlighted":null},{"source":"File","target":"PowerPoint","cost":5,"highlighted":null},{"source":"File","target":"Word","cost":3,"highlighted":null},{"source":"Browser","target":"Docs","cost":1,"highlighted":true},{"source":"Browser","target":"Maps","cost":1,"highlighted":null},{"source":"Browser","target":"Search","cost":1,"highlighted":null},{"source":"PowerPoint","target":"PowerPoint-Child1","cost":1,"highlighted":null},{"source":"PowerPoint","target":"PowerPoint-Child2","cost":1,"highlighted":null},{"source":"PowerPoint","target":"PowerPoint-Child3","cost":1,"highlighted":null},{"source":"Operating-System","target":"Browser","cost":2,"highlighted":true},{"source":"Operating-System","target":"Email","cost":5,"highlighted":null},{"source":"Operating-System","target":"Social-Media","cost":3,"highlighted":null},{"source":"Social-Media","target":"Games","cost":4,"highlighted":null},{"source":"Social-Media","target":"Photos","cost":1,"highlighted":null},{"source":"Social-Media","target":"Videos","cost":1,"highlighted":null},{"source":"Excel","target":"Excel-Child1","cost":1,"highlighted":null},{"source":"Excel","target":"Excel-Child2","cost":1,"highlighted":null},{"source":"Excel","target":"Excel-Child3","cost":1,"highlighted":null},{"source":"Word","target":"Word-Child1","cost":1,"highlighted":null},{"source":"Word","target":"Word-Child2","cost":1,"highlighted":null},{"source":"Word","target":"Word-Child3","cost":1,"highlighted":null},{"source":"Word","target":"Excel-Child1","cost":1,"highlighted":true},{"source":"Games","target":"Excel","cost":4,"highlighted":null},{"source":"Games","target":"PowerPoint","cost":5,"highlighted":null},{"source":"Games","target":"Word","cost":3,"highlighted":null},{"source":"Docs","target":"Excel","cost":4,"highlighted":null},{"source":"Docs","target":"PowerPoint","cost":5,"highlighted":null},{"source":"Docs","target":"Word","cost":3,"highlighted":true}]};
  console.log('DAG data:', data);
  
  // Calculate required width based on node positions
  const nodeExtent = d3.extent(data.nodes, d => d.x);
  const width = Math.max(800, nodeExtent[1] - nodeExtent[0] + 200); // Add padding
  const height = window.innerHeight;
  const nodeRadius = 30;
  
  const svg = d3.select('.tree-container')
    .append('svg')
    .attr('width', width)
    .attr('height', height)
    .append('g')
    .attr('transform', `translate(${width/2},60)`);

  // Create links
  const link = svg.append('g')
    .selectAll('path')
    .data(data.links)
    .join('path')
    .attr('class', d => d.highlighted ? 'link highlighted' : 'link')
    .attr('d', d => {
      const sourceNode = data.nodes.find(n => n.id === d.source);
      const targetNode = data.nodes.find(n => n.id === d.target);
      return `M${sourceNode.x},${sourceNode.y}
              C${sourceNode.x},${(sourceNode.y + targetNode.y) / 2}
               ${targetNode.x},${(sourceNode.y + targetNode.y) / 2}
               ${targetNode.x},${targetNode.y}`;
    });

  // Create nodes
  const node = svg.append('g')
    .selectAll('.node')
    .data(data.nodes)
    .join('g')
    .attr('class', d => d.highlighted ? 'node highlighted' : 'node')
    .attr('transform', d => `translate(${d.x},${d.y})`);

  // Add circles to nodes
  node.append('circle')
    .attr('r', nodeRadius);

  // Add labels to nodes
  node.append('text')
    .text(d => d.id)
    .call(wrap, nodeRadius * 1.8);

  // Text wrapping function
  function wrap(text, width) {
    text.each(function() {
      const text = d3.select(this);
      const words = text.text().split(/\s+/);
      const lines = [];
      let line = [];
      
      words.forEach(word => {
        line.push(word);
        if (line.join(' ').length > width/4) {
          lines.push(line.join(' '));
          line = [];
        }
      });
      if (line.length > 0) lines.push(line.join(' '));
      
      const lineHeight = 1.1;
      text.text(null);
      lines.forEach((l, i) => {
        text.append('tspan')
          .text(l)
          .attr('x', 0)
          .attr('dy', i === 0 ? -((lines.length-1) * lineHeight)/2 + 'em' : lineHeight + 'em');
      });
    });
  }

  // Add zoom behavior
  const zoom = d3.zoom()
    .scaleExtent([0.1, 4])
    .on('zoom', (event) => {
      svg.attr('transform', event.transform);
    });

  d3.select('svg').call(zoom);
  </script></body></html></html>
